title: feat(runner): host e2e sessions in another test runner

bugs.summary: A hosted session's timeout is recorded only inside the expiry timer callback, scheduled one tick after the deadline, and close() clears that timer first. A session closed after its deadline but before the timer ran (the poll cut at the deadline, or synchronous work that holds the event loop past it) closes with no failure and a passed trace, although the documented contract says close() returns the timeout.
bugs.trigger: openSession({ timeout: 20 }), keep the event loop busy for 60 ms (or let expect.poll be cut at the deadline), then call session.close(): it returns [] instead of a TEST_TIMEOUT failure and trace.md says passed.
bugs.hidden_test_cmd: cd packages/e2e && npm run build && node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/integration/open-host-deadline.test.ts
